services.name: Educational Programs
services.desc: Consider Guelph Civic Museum and McCrae House your community classroom, where history comes to life in inspiring and enriching ways. For school groups, our programs are designed to support the learning objectives of the Ontario curriculum through inquiry-based learning practices. For community groups, our programs provide unique, engaging life-long learning opportunities. Reflecting on the history of the place we now call Guelph, students will connect the past to the present to understand change over time.
